notes: Partition verified: all 15 source and 21 target IDs used exactly once; s002 is the only unrepresented unit and there are no added units.

Ἐν τῇ πρώτῃ μου ἀπολογίᾳ is rule 20 proper — μου is present and unspent, so it carries *my* and the article is displaced; rule 76's availability test confirms the pronoun has no other English of its own.

οὐδείς → *no one* heads on *no* under rule 17's generic-noun clause, as rule 69 heads *any man* on *any*; μή → *not* is an ordinary negative with no negative indefinite standing with it, so rules 41 and 59 are untouched.

Two heads carry recorded competing readings: s008 παρεγένετο → *took … part* heads on the support-verb complement *part* (rule 17), and s015 λογισθείη → *may it be laid … account* heads on *account* as the word glossing λογίζομαι (rule 91), *laid* being the light verb the English idiom supplies.
Both variant units are underdetermined with the projected base among the compatible readings and carry no FALLBACK EXCLUDED mark, so rule 97 does not apply.
